**Build passes now, 0 errors.**

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

1. `[options.js](src/core/options.js)` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Threw on `undefined.toFixed`.
2. `[retryPolicy.js](src/net/retryPolicy.js)` treated an unset flag as invalid instead of `false`. New config loader leaves it `undefined`, so it threw.

Remaining 8 warnings are deprecation noise from the bump, not errors.

Next: nothing.
